title: هل يتمكن الزيدي من فصل الدولة عن الطائفة؟
gist: This Arabic-language article (the raw language field is tagged 'en' despite the text being Arabic) argues that Khamenei's assassination and Mojtaba's succession turned Iran from a theocracy into a juntocracy of Revolutionary Guard generals, shifting the mobilizing doctrine binding Iraqi Shia factions from 'one jurist' to 'one shared fate.' Factions refusing disarmament doubled from five to ten after the July 16 US National Security Council meeting on strikes inside Iran, and Coordination Framework insiders told the author disarmament depends on the outcome of the US-Iran war rather than the American withdrawal timetable Prime Minister al-Zaidi cited at the White House, making his resignation the likely outcome.

themes.theme: From theocracy to juntocracy in Tehran

insights.claim: The assassination of Ali Khamenei and the transfer of the supreme leader position to his son Mojtaba turned Iran from a theocratic state run by the Guardian Jurist into a juntocratic state where the final word belongs to the council of Revolutionary Guard generals.
insights.so_what: Iranian regional decisions now flow through a military command structure, shortening escalation cycles and making proxy behavior less responsive to clerical restraint.
insights.locator: لقد أدى اغتيال السيد علي الخامنئي
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: The relationship between Tehran and its ideological networks in Iraq is shifting from the soft authority of doctrine to the hard authority of generals, obliging those networks to act inside their own countries because the generals rather than the jurist now issue orders.
insights.so_what: Iraqi factions become instruments of Iranian military planning rather than religious guidance, raising the odds of kinetic action on Iraqi soil.
insights.locator: هذا التحول البنيوي في سلطة النظام الإيراني
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: The ideological grip on followers has not weakened but changed form, moving from allegiance to the single jurist to allegiance to a single shared fate.
insights.so_what: A sharper analytical lens than 'Iranian influence is declining': the mobilizing frame is now survivalist, which is harder to negotiate away.
insights.quote: انها في الواقع قد تبدلت من الفقيه الواحد الى المصير الواحد.
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: The narrative that the fall of Iran means the fall of Shia rule across the region is promoted by Tehran and accepted by many inside Iraq, including people who do not believe in the Guardianship of the Jurist or belong to armed factions.
insights.so_what: Popular acceptance of the existential frame widens the support base for armed factions beyond their formal membership.
insights.quote: فسقوط إيران يعني سقوط الحكم “الشيعي” في المنطقة
insights.locator: فمجلس جنرالات الحرس يستخدم الان المصير الواحد
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: The number of Iraqi armed factions refusing to disarm rose from five to ten after the latest escalation of American attacks on Iran following the July 16 US National Security Council meeting, which leaks indicate discussed plans for ground operations and airstrikes on Iranian infrastructure.
insights.so_what: US military pressure on Iran doubled the count of Iraqi factions refusing disarmament, an inverse reaction that undercuts the coercion strategy.
insights.locator: هكذا نفهم الارتفاع الكبير في عدد الفصائل
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: On Friday July 24 Iraqi army and police forces accompanied by Popular Mobilization security troops failed to storm the special forces camp of Harakat al-Nujaba south of Baghdad after Nujaba forces, formally part of the PMF as the 12th brigade, threatened to arrest the government forces if they entered.
insights.so_what: A PMF-registered brigade successfully repelling the state it nominally belongs to shows disarmament is not enforceable by Iraqi security forces.
insights.locator: وفي نفس السياق نفهم فشل محاولة قوات الجيش
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: Iraq is neither a state of individual nor institutional rule and is neither parliamentary nor presidential; it is simply a state of sectarian rule in which each sect holds a representative political institution, a presidential-level post, and an agreed sovereign ministry.
insights.so_what: Predict Iraqi policy from sect allocation rather than formal constitutional roles when assessing oil, budget, and security decisions.
insights.locator: فالعراق ليس دولة حكم فردي ولا مؤسسي
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: The sects consolidated into two political institutions, with the Coordination Framework speaking for the Shia excluding the Sadrists and the National Political Council representing the Sunnis, while the Kurds split into two parties.
insights.so_what: Two sectarian bodies, not the cabinet, are the real counterparties in Iraqi political risk analysis.
insights.locator: وفي تطوير لهذه النظرية الطائفية تجمعت هذه الطوائف
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: When the Sadrists tried after their 2021 election win to build a cross-sectarian institution to form a government, the Iranian-backed Coordination Framework confronted them with firepower rather than politics alone and forced them to withdraw.
insights.so_what: Force, not votes, resolved the last attempt at cross-sectarian government, setting the ceiling for any reformist prime minister.
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: Former Prime Minister Mohammed al-Sudani, whose mixed Shia-Sunni bloc won the 2025 elections after he had distanced himself from the Coordination Framework for months, pragmatically returned to it rather than contest government formation.
insights.so_what: Even election winners must re-enter the sectarian bloc, so electoral outcomes are weak predictors of Iraqi policy direction.
insights.locator: وقد وصلت تلك الرسالة بوضوح الى رئيس الوزراء السابق
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: The Coordination Framework has established itself as a structural mechanism above the state by using its parliamentary seat superiority to appoint both the president of the republic and the speaker of parliament.
insights.so_what: Control of the presidency and speakership lets the Framework block any externally backed agenda regardless of who is prime minister.
insights.locator: هكذا نجح الإطار التنسيقي في تثبيت نفسه
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: Senior Coordination Framework members told the author that disarming the Iraqi armed factions is not tied to the date of American troop withdrawal as al-Zaidi claimed at the White House, but to the outcome of the ongoing Iranian-American confrontation in the region.
insights.so_what: Disarmament is a hostage to the Iran war outcome, so no Baghdad-level agreement or withdrawal timetable can deliver it.
insights.locator: فأن أعضاء مهمين في الإطار التنسيقي أخبروا الكاتب
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: Important forces within the Coordination Framework will not support al-Zaidi in fulfilling his promise to Trump to dissolve the factions before year-end unless the Iranian regime's safety is guaranteed and Tehran actually consents to the disarmament.
insights.so_what: The year-end disarmament deadline is very likely to be missed, setting up a US-Iraq rupture.
insights.locator: فإذا لم يتم ضمان سلامة النظام الإيراني
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: Although al-Zaidi told a Framework meeting he would be forced into armed confrontation to disarm the factions, he knows the Framework will not permit a Shia-Shia military clash, leaving him only resignation once the White House withdraws support for failing its core mission.
insights.so_what: Resignation is the author's base case for the Iraqi premiership, implying renewed Baghdad instability within months.
insights.locator: وعلى الرغم من ان الزيدي صرّح في احد اجتماعات الإطار
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: Despite the fanfare and major economic agreements signed during al-Zaidi's Washington visit, experience with all previous prime ministers shows that what matters is not the decision or external support but internal cross-sectarian, cross-ethnic agreement on the supremacy and independence of the state.
insights.so_what: Discount White House visits and signed deals as predictors of Iraqi delivery; internal consensus is the only reliable indicator.
insights.locator: وعلى الرغم من الأجواء الصاخبة والأضواء المبهرة
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu

insights.claim: Unless al-Zaidi curbs the role of sectarian institutions in state decisionmaking he will merely be another executive manager of policies set by the sectarian governing council, and his real battle is restoring the state's monopoly over its sovereignty rather than disarming the factions.
insights.so_what: Reframes the benchmark for Iraqi reform from militia counts to sovereignty over sectarian councils, a far higher and slower bar.
insights.quote: فالمعركة التي أمام الزيدي هي ليست نزع سلاح الفصائل، وإنما استعادة احتكار الدولة لسيادتها.
insights.locator: وما لم يتمكن السيد الزيدي من تحجيم دور المؤسسات الطائفية
insights.speaker: Andrea Ratiu
